title: Changelog & Updates
subtitle: Track the latest updates, feature releases, and bug fixes across all VibePress Studio products.

entries.version: v1.0.6 — Complete Product Documentation & Studio Consolidation
changes: Integrated complete enterprise documentation from PDF specs across Home, Products Directory, Product Page (9-part docs: CPT salc_link, Redirect 301/302/307/200, Smart ToS Amazon §6, FTC auto-disclosure, Stripe Checkout, Keyword Auto-Linker, Health Scanner) and Docs Hub 9-chapter manual — see README.md and CHANGELOG.md for file:line refs.

Standardized plugin version v1.0.0 → v1.0.6 across 9 files (README, CHANGELOG, docs/page.tsx:144, lab/page.tsx, page.tsx:177, changelog.json, cloaker.json:10, pricing.json, products.json:17) — 100% Feature Complete.

Hard-purged ShelfMaster Desktop Software (Tauri 2.x): deleted 45 files — src-tauri/*, updater hooks/components, /products/shelfmaster (374 lines), /settings, shelfmaster.json (227 lines) — net -2132 lines (git show 0164f54).

Enforced tagline "High-Performance Digital Tools" across site.json:11, navigation.json, footer.json, layout.tsx and purged all desktop references (about, privacy, terms, docs). Build verified 13 static routes — live at vibepressstudio.vercel.app.

Added Tauri 2.x auto-updater (Cargo 0.4.0, updater/process/dialog plugins, ECDSA signing, dual GitHub/Vercel endpoints, useAutoUpdater hook idle|checking|available|downloading|downloaded|error|upToDate).
Added UpdateModal (Radix Dialog, progress bar) + AutoUpdater controller + Settings page /settings + public/updater/latest.json fallback. Verified cargo check + npm run build (19 routes).

entries.version: v0.3.0 — Brand Redesign & Studio Lab Polish
changes: Integrated complete Google Stitch Design System with custom color tokens, Inter/JetBrains Mono typography, and responsive layouts.
Renamed top navigation menu from 'Marketplace' to 'Studio' and migrated page route from /pricing to /lab (301 redirect in next.config.ts:12).
Added SVG brand logo to Header, Mobile Drawer, and Footer, along with modern vector favicon (icon.svg).
Fixed primary button and tab text contrast ensuring full WCAG AAA compliance.
Rebranded site to pre-launch registration posture; added pricing/lab portal, cloaker status (100% Feature Complete) and ShelfMaster 80% readiness content.
Rewrote docs hub (Cloaker 5 phases, ShelfMaster 6 chapters), products directory, and navigation/footer to single pre-launch tier (preLaunchUrl: /lab).
Removed legacy legal pages and Freemius/AppSumo distribution URLs; verified 17 static routes and sitemap.

entries.version: v1.0.6 (Smart Affiliate Link Cloaker) — Core Compliance & Routing
changes: Implemented strict FTC auto-disclosure injector (<aside role="note"> callout/badge/minimal/subtle at top/bottom/before_first_link).
Added support for 307 temporary redirects (default uncached) and 200 iFrame masking with branded gradient.
Full compatibility with WordPress 6.0+ and PHP 8.0+ (WPCS/PSR-12), local click analytics (wp_salc_clicks, 7 charts, CSV export).
